_schema_questions_answered_2026_08_16: CLAUDE.md Next Steps item 2's four open questions, now answered from the real settings: (a) forced fumble is its own category, separate from recovered -- YES, 'Each Fumble Forced (FF)' = 1 (was guessed at 0). (b) a plain non-lost 'Fumble' penalty exists as its own category, separate from 'Fumble Lost' -- YES, 'Total Fumbles (FUM)' = -1 stacks with 'Total Fumbles Lost (FUML)' = -2 (a lost fumble costs -3 total, not just -2) -- this league has BOTH categories, the placeholder only ever modeled fumble_lost. (c) offensive yardage-milestone bonuses ARE configurable -- YES, but the real bands are narrower than guessed: only ONE tier each (400+ passing=2.5, 200+ rush/rec=1), not the two-tier 300/400 and 100/200 structure this file used to guess -- see the milestones section below, already updated. There's also a genuinely NEW mechanic the placeholder never modeled at all: a flat +1 bonus for any TD play (pass/rush/rec) covering 50+ yards, on top of the base 6 -- see _new_mechanics_not_yet_built. (d) defensive/return TD handling -- ANSWERED, and it changes backend/dst.py's def_st_td shape, not just its value: the real settings show only ONE explicit TD-credit line under Miscellaneous, 'Fumble Recovered for TD (FTD)' = 6 -- no separate 'Interception Return TD' or 'Punt/Kickoff Return TD' bonus line appears anywhere in the settings (Passing/Rushing/Receiving/Kicking/Miscellaneous/Defensive-Players sections were all captured top to bottom with no visible gaps). dst.py's DST_TD_COLUMNS currently sums nflreadpy's def_tds (which bundles INT-return AND fumble-return TDs together) plus special_teams_tds into one def_st_td bucket, crediting all of them at the same rate -- the real rule looks narrower (fumble-recovery TDs only get the +6; INT-return and kick/punt-return TDs may get nothing beyond the base def_int/return-yardage points already awarded). Needs a code follow-up to confirm nflreadpy can actually separate fumble-return TDs from INT-return TDs within def_tds, and narrow dst.py's mapping if so -- not just a config-value change. Flagged in CLAUDE.md Next Steps.

(2) def_st_td's shape narrowing per the schema-questions note above. Both are new Next Steps items, not done by this file.

_def_st_td_rename_note: 2026-09-02: this league's single D/ST touchdown rule is ESPN's "Fumble Recovered for TD (FTD) = 6" (confirmed v15, docs/research/dst-td-decomposition.md). It was keyed as def_st_td when this was the only league; league-2 has a genuinely different rule set that needs def_st_td to mean a special-teams return TD, so this key was renamed to def_fumble_rec_td. Pure rename -- same source column (fumble_recovery_tds), same 6 points, identical scoring.
_def_return_yd_removed_2026_09_02: REMOVED (was 0.1 pts/yd). At 0.1 pts per return yard this single category produced 11.46 of a 16.66 pts/game D/ST average -- 68.8% of every D/ST score -- and put four D/STs in the week-10 top 20 at 20.6-22.6 points, against a typical ESPN D/ST of 7-9. The v16 audit flagged it and deliberately left it as a league-settings question. It was resolved 2026-09-02 by league-2's complete ESPN 'Scoring Settings' screen, which lists every D/ST category and has NO return-yardage line at all; league-2 scores 6.57 pts/game. ESPN's default D/ST set does not include return yardage either. Removed with the builder's explicit confirmation. Effect: league-1 D/ST mean 16.66 -> 5.20 pts/game.
_unconfirmed: tiers.def_yards_allowed -- the only block here never seen on a real ESPN settings screen. Re-examined 2026-09-02 and the evidence now points toward it being CORRECT, which is the opposite of the second audit's initial read. Three reasons. (1) ESPN's own D/ST support page states a defence gains and loses points on yards allowed, so unlike def_return_yd this is a genuine ESPN category, not an invention. (2) The points-allowed ladder in this same placeholder block (10/7/4/1/0/-1/-4) is character-for-character identical to league-2's CONFIRMED values, so whoever wrote this block was transcribing ESPN's standard table rather than guessing -- and that table verified exactly where it could be checked. (3) The only counter-evidence is that league-2's screen has no yards-allowed line, but league-2 is a heavily customised league (4-point passing TDs, six FG bands, scoring 2-point conversions), so its commissioner switching the category off says nothing about this league. Impact if wrong: mean -0.52 pts/game, sd 2.31, range -7 to +5. Removing it moves the D/ST mean from 5.20 to 5.72 and leaves the ranking almost intact -- Spearman 0.944, 7 of the top 8 unchanged, largest single move 9 places. Low stakes either way; confirm opportunistically rather than chasing it.
